verses.text: Yahweh said to me, “Ezekiel, sing a sad funeral song a which will be a parable about two of the kings of Israel.
She taught one of them to hunt for other animals to kill,
When people from other nations heard about him,
His mother waited for him to return,
He hunted along with other lions for animals to kill,
So people of other nations planned to kill him,
They tied him with chains Also, say to the Israeli people,
‘It is as though [SIM] your mother was a grapevine
That grapevine grew and became taller than all the nearby trees;
Now that vine has been planted in a hot, dry desert.
A fire started to burn its stem, That funeral song must be sung very sadly.”
